env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
mkdir $WORK/bin

cd a/main
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/sysoa$GOEXE ./cmd
stderr 'ERROR \[capabilities::unclassified_assembly\]: Transitive dependency ''example\.com/adep'' holds assembly files'
stderr 'example\.com/amain/cmd'
stderr '-> example\.com/adep'
stderr 'transitive_unsafe_allowlist'
cd ../..

cd b/main
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/sysob$GOEXE ./cmd
stderr 'ERROR \[capabilities::unclassified_assembly\]: Transitive dependency ''example\.com/bdep'' holds assembly files'
cd ../..

cd c/main
logos list ./cmd
! stderr 'capabilities::'
cd ../..

cd d/main
logos list ./cmd
! stderr 'capabilities::'
cd ../..

cd e/main
logos list ./cmd
stderr '\[capabilities::unclassified_assembly\].*example\.com/edep'
cd ../..

cd f/main
logos list ./cmd
! stderr 'capabilities::'
cd ../..

-- a/main/go.mod --
module example.com/amain

go 1.27

require example.com/adep v0.0.0

replace example.com/adep => ../dep

-- a/main/logos.toml --
[capabilities]
transitive_unsafe = "deny"

-- a/main/cmd/main.go --
package main

import "example.com/adep"

func main() { println(adep.Init()) }

-- a/dep/go.mod --
module example.com/adep

go 1.27

-- a/dep/dep.go --
package adep

func Init() int { return 1 }

-- a/dep/blob.syso --
not an object file, the audit never reads it

-- b/main/go.mod --
module example.com/bmain

go 1.27

require example.com/bdep v0.0.0

replace example.com/bdep => ../dep

module example.com/bdep

go 1.27

-- b/dep/dep.go --

func Init() int { return 1 }

-- b/dep/blob_plan9_arm.syso --
a file that the current configuration excludes

-- c/main/go.mod --
module example.com/cmain

go 1.27

require example.com/cdep v0.0.0

replace example.com/cdep => ../dep

-- c/main/logos.toml --

transitive_unsafe = "deny"
transitive_unsafe_allowlist = ["example.com/cdep/**"]

-- c/main/cmd/main.go --

func main() { println(cdep.Init()) }

-- c/dep/go.mod --
module example.com/cdep

go 1.27

-- c/dep/dep.go --
package cdep

func Init() int { return 1 }

-- c/dep/blob.syso --
a granted dependency may hold an object

-- d/main/go.mod --
module example.com/dmain

-- d/main/logos.toml --

-- d/main/cmd/main.go --

-- d/main/lib/lib.go --

func Init() int { return 1 }

-- d/main/lib/blob.syso --
first-party objects are the program's own
